llm.summary: This is a plain markdown workflow for finding and fixing bugs, with no hidden install code or persistence, though its activation triggers are broader than ideal.

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is bug review, and its instructions focus on language detection, reproduction planning, defect documentation, minimal fixes, tests, and verification evidence.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow may read project code, run normal development linters/tests, and prepare code changes; this is coherent with bug fixing, but triggers like "bugs," "fixes," and "verification" are broad and could invoke it in ordinary development conversations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only SKILL.md and three markdown module files; metadata and hashes match, static scan is clean, and there are no package scripts, binaries, hooks, or automatic installers in the reviewed artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Suggested commands are standard project-local test and static-analysis commands for Rust, Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Java; no unrelated network access, credential access, profile reading, or data transfer is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, credential/session handling, autostart behavior, or privilege escalation appears in the artifact; optional references to the broader Claude Code plugin are disclosed and not executed by this skill package.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install if you want a structured bug-review workflow that can guide an agent to inspect code, run tests/linters, and prepare fixes. Be aware that its broad triggers may activate more often than intended, and review any proposed code changes or optional separate Claude Code plugin installation before accepting them.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger terms are relevant to bug review but over-general; this is a scoping quality issue rather than evidence of hidden, deceptive, or unsafe behavior.
[static-scan] expected: Static scan reported no findings, and artifact inspection confirmed markdown-only workflow content with no executable install path.
[virustotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry is clean with no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
